1.

Now all is ready! Come! Come to my meal, come! Come, rich and poor, old, young, To be richly filled! Come!

2.

Now all is ready! Come! Let nothing hinder you, Neither the yoke of oxen, nor house and home, God calls you to Himself!

3.

Now all is ready! Come! O, what joyful tidings From Jesus, who is in heaven In glory with God!

4.

Now all is ready! Come! See, heaven is opened, God’s love you may enjoy, For Christ died for you.

5.

Now all is ready! Come! Every hindrance is gone. His love God to men In Christ has shown here.

6.

Now all is ready! Come! Before the door is shut, O come! O sinner, your Saviour Welcomes you, O come!
